name: keynote
description: Create, edit, inspect, and export Apple Keynote presentations through a bundled MCP server and presentation design skill.

shortDescription.en-US: Create and edit Keynote decks with AI.
shortDescription.zh-CN: 让 AI 创建、编辑并导出 Keynote 演示文稿。

longDescription.en-US: Control Apple Keynote on macOS through AppleScript. Create presentations, manage slides and content, inspect layouts, add build animations, capture slide previews, and export PDF files. Includes a presentation design skill with tested layout and typography guidance.
longDescription.zh-CN: 通过 AppleScript 在 macOS 上控制 Apple Keynote：创建演示文稿、管理幻灯片与内容、检查布局、添加构建动画、生成幻灯片预览并导出 PDF。插件同时内置经过实践验证的排版与演示设计 Skill。

defaultPrompt: 为我创建一份结构清晰、视觉精致的 Keynote 演示文稿
检查当前 Keynote 的版式并修复文字裁切和重叠
把当前 Keynote 导出为 PDF

mcpServers.name: Keynote Control
mcpServers.description: Control Apple Keynote through the bundled keynote-mcp runtime.
permissions: macOS only; requires Apple Keynote to be installed
Starts a local Python MCP process through uv and may download Python plus locked dependencies on first launch
Controls Keynote through Apple Events and AppleScript
Can create, edit, delete, save, close, screenshot, and export presentations at user-selected paths
Build animation tools use System Events UI scripting and require Accessibility permission
Optional Unsplash tools send search requests and download images when an API key is configured

installReview: This initial version runs only on macOS and exits with an actionable error on other platforms.
Install uv before first use. The launcher searches PATH, ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, and /usr/local/bin.
The first launch can download Python 3.12 and dependencies described by the bundled uv.lock file.
macOS will ask whether the Python runtime may automate Keynote. Build animations additionally require Accessibility access.
Only inspection tools are auto-allowed; all presentation mutations, filesystem writes, UI scripting, and network tools require approval by default.
The optional Unsplash access key is stored by Anybox and injected only into the MCP process.
